# HEIC preview fixture

`heic-single.heic` is the unmodified `test/fixtures/heic-single.heic` of [exifr](https://github.com/MikeKovarik/exifr)
(MIT License, Copyright (c) 2017 Mike Kovařík), commit 6cbf6e921688faf7723e1f2e0b9e672d1f0aa21c. It checks that a HEIC photo is shown
in a browser without built-in HEIC support. It has no GPS, so it is reported as missing GPS.
